decisions.title: Decision corpus import path
decisions.statement: Add compact source-to-decision import rows to the decision-packet corpus through a validated importer instead of hand-editing the large benchmark fixture.
decisions.falsifier: A new source-to-decision decision still requires hand-editing the large notes-baseline fixture before packet evals can see it.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove DB ingestion, source truth, or broad corpus quality.
decisions.noteText: Decision corpus import path. Use compact source-to-decision import rows with validation instead of hand-editing the large benchmark fixture.

decisions.title: Manual fixture editing only
decisions.statement: Maintain the decision-packet corpus only by hand-editing the monolithic notes-baseline JSON fixture.
decisions.falsifier: The importer converts compact source-to-decision rows into corpus decisions, notes, and cases.
decisions.noteText: Manual fixture editing only. Hand-edit the monolithic notes-baseline JSON fixture for every new decision.

decisions.title: Import without link validation
decisions.statement: Accept imported decision rows without validating current, stale, and rejected links for imported cases.
decisions.falsifier: An imported case references a rejected or stale decision in the wrong slot and the importer still accepts it.
decisions.noteText: Import without link validation. Accept imported decision rows without validating current stale rejected links for imported cases.

cases.task: How should a new source-to-decision item enter the decision-packet corpus without manual fixture editing only or unvalidated links?
cases.baselineFailureRationale: A notes-only path can recall the import idea, but it cannot expose stale manual editing and rejected unvalidated-link paths as governed packet fields.
